verdict.rationale: Metronome's own rate-card mechanism applies one change across many contracts at once: when a subscription rate's price changes, all contracts inherit it. This is a narrow form of bulk operation. The evidence shows no general bulk or batch API for acting on many customers, contracts or invoices in one call. High-volume event ingestion is a throughput claim, not a bulk-operations capability. Missing for 10: documented batch/bulk endpoints for arbitrary object updates, bulk actions in the UI, bulk import details, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: All contracts inherit the new pricing and customers are billed at the new rate at the start of the next billing period.
